page_title: LYO 1-0 HAV | Lyon v Le Havre 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.

90+3' Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement. Le Havre are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+1' The corner from Adam Karabec (Lyon) is hurriedly cleared.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) replaces Pavel Sulc.
88' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) tries to find Issa Soumare, but he puts too much power on the pass.
85' Substitution. Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hans Hateboer walks off.
84' Dangerous play by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon win a free kick.
82' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
82' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) will deliver the corner kick.
81' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Le Havre are awarded a corner kick.

81' What an amazing save by Dominik Greif! Noam Obougou (Le Havre) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails. The ball is out of play. Le Havre win a corner kick.
80' Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the left post.
78' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
78' Here is a change. Ally Samatta is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Noam Obougou (Le Havre).
78' Substitution. Younes Namli walks off the pitch and Kenny Quetant (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
77' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' Hans Hateboer (Lyon) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
77' Adam Karabec (Lyon) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
76' Pavel Sulc is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.

75' Tyler Morton (Lyon) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
74' Le Havre couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Dominik Greif (Lyon) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Karabec (Lyon) replacing Martin Satriano.
73' Substitution. Khalis Merah makes his way off the pitch and Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) comes on as his replacement.
71' Younes Namli (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
71' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
68' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) duly receives a yellow card.

68' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Ally Samatta (Le Havre) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Dominik Greif pulls off a brilliant save.
66' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Pavel Sulc (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Le Havre win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
64' The game is interrupted now, Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Tyler Morton (Lyon) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Yassine Kechta will be replaced by Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre).
63' The game has come to an end for Loic Nego. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Fode Doucoure (Le Havre).
62' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
59' 60:40 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
55' Pavel Sulc picks out Tyler Morton (Lyon) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
52' 1 - 0 Afonso Moreira produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Pavel Sulc (Lyon) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
51' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post.

48' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Mory Diaw pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
47' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul. Lyon are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
47' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) whips the ball into the box and Pavel Sulc takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick to Lyon.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Mory Diaw (Le Havre) leaps to collect the ball.
45' Clinton Mata (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Lyon will have a corner.
44' A pass travels right across the box to Pavel Sulc (Lyon) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Mory Diaw denies him with a decent save.
42' Mory Diaw makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Hans Hateboer (Lyon) after a cross from the side.
40' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Hans Hateboer (Lyon) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
38' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
38' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) doesn't take advantage of the chance to score from the penalty spot. He shoots to the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif leaps out to thwart his effort.
38' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
37' Tyler Morton (Lyon) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
37' Tyler Morton (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Marc Bollengier signals a set piece. Le Havre are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
37' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
36' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
35' Martin Satriano (Lyon) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marc Bollengier signals. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
32' What a miskick by Loic Nego (Le Havre). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
31' Tyler Morton (Lyon) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Le Havre have a free kick.
30' The linesman signals that Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
29' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
28' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Looks like Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

26' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle as Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
24' Loic Nego (Le Havre) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
23' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Lyon.
21' The ball rebounds to Pavel Sulc (Lyon) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
20' The game is interrupted as Khalis Merah (Lyon) is flagged offside.
18' That's unlucky! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
17' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon will take a free kick.
15' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Free kick. Lyon will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
14' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mory Diaw, who smothers the ball.
14' Tyler Morton (Lyon) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mory Diaw is well positioned and punches the ball away.

13' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Lyon force a corner. They send men into the box.
13' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
12' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Lyon! Play can continue.
9' Referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lyon. Let’s see what happens!
8' Loic Nego (Le Havre) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
8' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
6' Younes Namli (Le Havre) commits a foul and Marc Bollengier immediately signals a free kick. Lyon have a free kick.
2' Martin Satriano (Lyon) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Lyon will take the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will officiate today.
